designs.name: 奶油英短·暖围兜
designs.spec: A cream British Shorthair kitten: pale warm cream short dense plush fur, soft round cheeks but normal unflattened feline muzzle, honey amber eyes, pink nose, lighter ivory chin, same cream tail. ONE simple tiny pale sage-green cotton triangular bib, a small rounded point at chest, thin neck ties visible at back. No flower, no other clothing. Thin circular warm-gold halo. Cozy and sunny.
designs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production character turnaround sheet for original short-film IP Little Wishes Office.
Create ONE large high-resolution landscape character reference sheet, a precise 2-row by 4-column grid, eight full-body views total. Each row shows the SAME individual kitten standing naturally on FOUR paws, with identical proportions, fur markings and accessories. Columns in exact order: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE (nose points left), BACK, RIGHT PROFILE (nose points right). No three-quarter angles. Row 1 DAILY: no wings at all. Row 2 ANGEL: same kitten, same pose and accessories, plus a single pair of small realistic white feather wings attached at upper back, partially extended so the silhouette remains visible. BOTH rows have a delicate thin warm-gold angel halo floating above head with a natural little gap. The halo and occasional wings are the ONLY supernatural anatomical elements.
Style: convincing real kitten studio photography, individual fur strands, natural feline eyes/pupils, anatomically correct feline paws and legs, normal kitten-sized head and ears, healthy normal legs, normal muzzle (not flat face), natural whiskers, realistic moist nose. Cute through real kitten proportions and gentle alert curiosity, not cartoon, not Pixar, not doll, not plush, not anime, no human teeth/smile, no human hands, no standing upright. Young kitten about 4 months in visual age, no scars or sad expression. Warm optimistic helpful personality shown subtly in relaxed ears and bright curious eyes.
Background neutral warm ivory seamless, soft photographic daylight, slight grounding shadows, no environment props. Same camera height, scale, lighting, and ground line in all cells. Full body, tail, paws, halo and wing tips completely visible with padding; no overlapping cells. Small legible English column labels and DAILY / ANGEL row labels, simple typography, no decorative clutter, no watermark. Accessory side must be anatomically consistent across rotations; tail markings and eye color never change.

designs.name: 蓝双色布偶·小雏菊
designs.spec: A blue bicolor Ragdoll kitten, natural semi-long fine fur (not exaggerated): clear symmetrical white inverted-V mask on face, soft blue-gray ears and upper face sides, white muzzle/chest/belly/four legs, soft blue-gray saddle on back and entire fluffy tail, clear blue eyes, pink nose. ONE tiny real white daisy with warm yellow center tucked just below kitten's anatomical LEFT ear on a discreet clip, always on that same side, no bib, no clothes. Warm-gold thin halo. Gentle bright curious look.
